visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two young women appear in a brightly lit, upscale bridal salon. One has long brown hair and wears a white strap top, the other has long black hair and a white t-shirt. They are filming themselves in a selfie-style shot, smiling and speaking excitedly. The background shows wood-paneled walls and a sleek interior. (2) The scene shifts to the brown-haired woman standing in front of a storefront labeled 'Grace Kelly', pointing at a large mannequin wearing a dramatic, multi-layered white wedding gown. She wears a leopard-print tank top and black shorts. (3) The black-haired woman is now wearing a plush blue robe, speaking directly to the camera in a room with neutral-toned walls and soft curtains. (4) A series of reveals begin. The brown-haired woman peeks through thick gray velvet curtains and then steps out, showcasing a sparkling white gown with a deep V-neckline. A masked assistant is visible in the background, along with a large mirror reflecting the gown's back. (5) A brief animated clip of a bald monk praying with his hands together is shown against a traditional background. (6) Further reveals show the woman in various styles: a form-fitting lace mermaid gown, a short yellow ruffled dress, and a short off-the-shoulder white dress with a bow detail. (7) The two women stand together again, the black-haired woman still in the blue robe and the brown-haired woman in the short white dress, discussing the outfits. (8) The video concludes with the brown-haired woman back in a long, intricate lace wedding gown, posing in front of the mirrors while looking at the camera.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-tempo, upbeat electronic pop music starts immediately. Two female voices speak with high arousal and bright pitch, expressing excitement about wedding dress shopping. (2) A sharp 'Whoosh' sound effect punctuates a visual transition. The primary speaker continues in a friendly, animated tone, describing the location. (3) Vocal texture changes as a third voice, a deep and calm male narrator from a meme clip, says 'Meiyou nazhong shisu de yuwang' with low pitch and flat contour. (4) The music resumes its energetic beat. Multiple short 'Whoosh' and 'Ding' sound effects coincide with dress reveals. The female voices exhibit high intensity and rapid speech while reacting with 'Wa!' and phrases of praise. (5) The final segment features conversational dialogue between the two women. The speech rate is moderate, with clear articulation and rising intonations as they ask questions to the audience. The BGM remains constant until the end.
